name: Jebus
overview: Jebus is a male figure identified as a Jebusite and noted as the son of Canaan. His lineage places him within the descendants of Canaan, emphasizing his connection to the early inhabitants of the land associated with the Canaanites. There are no additional notes providing further detail about his life or role.
namesAndTitles: The name 'Jebus' appears as a proper name in Scripture without a given meaning or title. It is not indicated that this name was given by God, and no specific significance is attached to the name beyond its identification in Genesis 10:16.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Jebus as a son of Canaan, establishing his place within the genealogical line of Canaan’s descendants. No other familial relationships are documented beyond this paternal connection.
scriptureSignificance: Jebus is significant as a representative of the Jebusite tribe, descended from Canaan, which situates him within the broader biblical narrative of the peoples inhabiting the land promised to Abraham's descendants. His mention in Genesis 10:16 contributes to the understanding of the genealogical origins of various Canaanite groups, highlighting the fulfillment of God's sovereign plan through the dispersion of nations.
